source_data.age: **_Age._** A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.
source_data.alignment: **_Alignment._** Most halflings are lawful good. As a rule, they are good-hearted and kind, hate to see others in pain, and have no tolerance for oppression. They are also very orderly and traditional, leaning heavily on the support of their community and the comfort of their old ways.
source_data.asi_desc: **_Ability Score Increase._** Your Dexterity score increases by 2.
source_data.desc:
## Halfling Traits
Your halfling character has a number of traits in common with all other halflings.
source_data.languages: **_Languages._** You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling. The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong. Almost all halflings speak Common to converse with the people in whose lands they dwell or through which they are traveling.
source_data.name: Halfling
source_data.size: **_Size._** Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.
source_data.speed_desc: **_Speed._** Your base walking speed is 25 feet.
source_data.traits:
**_Lucky._** When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

**_Brave._** You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

**_Halfling Nimbleness._** You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

## Halfling Traits
Your halfling character has a number of traits in common with all other halflings.
en.name: Halfling

ru.description:
**Тип существа:** Гуманоид

**Размер:** Маленький (около 2–3 футов ростом)

**Скорость:** 30 футов

Как полурослик, вы обладаете следующими особыми чертами.

**Храбрость.** Вы совершаете с преимуществом спасброски, чтобы избежать или прекратить состояние «Испуганный».

**Проворство полурослика.** Вы можете перемещаться сквозь пространство любого существа, размер которого больше вашего, но не можете останавливаться в том же пространстве.

**Удача.** Когда вы выбрасываете 1 на d20 при проверке d20, вы можете перебросить кость и должны использовать новый результат.

**Природная скрытность.** Вы можете совершить действие Скрыться, даже если вас заслоняет только существо, размер которого как минимум на один больше вашего.
ru.name: Полурослик
